_comment: Commands and paths that create background persistence OUTSIDE mChatAI+ Routines: launchd, cron, at, login items (mchatai_macOS/docs/ROUTINES_ARCHITECTURE.md §5.3, §8). R10 denies these in agent turns (before any armed auto-allow) and points the agent at routines.propose; the Background Jobs view lists what already exists under 'Outside mChatAI+'. Read by ForeignSchedulerPatterns (Routines/RoutineContent.swift). The binary carries the same entries as a FLOOR and unions this file on top by id, so content can add or tighten patterns but can never remove a floor pattern. Regexes use the ICU/NSRegularExpression dialect (lookahead allowed) and must also compile in Python (checked by mchatai_macOS/scripts/check_routine_content.py). Globs: ~ is the user's home, ** matches any depth.

commands.description: Loading, enabling or starting a launchd job. Read-only launchctl subcommands (list, print) stay allowed.
Installing or editing a crontab. `crontab -l` (list) stays allowed.
Queueing a one-off job with at(1). Anchored to the start of a command so the English word 'at' in arguments doesn't match.
Adding a login item through System Events.
Editing the background task management / login items database.
Registering a login item, launch agent or daemon from code (matched in commands and in files an agent writes).

paths.description: Per-user launchd agents. Writing a plist here is the usual way a script gets scheduled outside mChatAI+.
